The '''Gerrard V Rebels''' was partly formed by segments of the [[Gerrard V military]], and comprised both ground troops and [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], they staged an [[Uprising on Gerrard V|uprising]] on [[Gerrard V]], seizing the planetary [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Harazod]]. An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] counterstrike destroyed the navy in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of Gerrard V, and forced the Rebels to retreat to the [[capitol building]]. The Rebels leader, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Camon Udeon]], refused surrender terms, forcing Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Jion Trynn]] to bombard Harazod's urban center from orbit. Admiral Trynn believed the Rebels were associated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], but without Udeon or local leaders to interrogate, he could not be certain.
